currentBaselineQualification: Khadra was installed during this review. This report pins current d769 metadata; the Ettahrir point and base393 retain the earlier triage fields, and the complete five-imada inventory was freshly read.
decision: Support one explicitly reviewed Ettahrir picker identity by associating the existing suburb point with timetable base393. Preserve both accepted coordinates and every administrative or unrelated same-name choice.
reasoning: The cached and fresh OSM object is explicitly a suburb named Hay/Cite Ettahrir. MSSA uses Hay Ettahrir as a Tunis address locality; Enda independently describes its Cite Ettahrir community space and inhabitants of the quarter. These identify an inhabited quarter, not merely the delegation title.

The app constructs base393 from a point-based timetable row named Ettahrir, separately from administrative polygon records. Associating the unqualified quarter point with that row is a reviewed display inference supported by the source names and locality evidence; it does not equate the suburb with any imada or redefine delegation1157.

No same-name competing settlement occurs within the current Tunis context inventory. All three non-target raw name peers are in other governorates and remain distinct. Distance and nearest-source arithmetic are corroboration only.
